content:
Jordan Park: Hi all, quick onboarding snag. When I try to sign into Okta I see two accounts for meone linked to jordan@redwood.com and one to jordan.park.personal@gmail.com. The personal one is marked as primary in Okta? I also got a 1Password invite to the personal email. I want to register my YubiKey and use a passkey on my Mac, but Okta keeps trying to push Windows Hello. Anyone know how to clean this up?
Luke (People Ops): Hey Jordan, welcome! :wave: That sounds like we had both your personal and work contact on file. Can you DM me the personal address? I'll remove the personal contact and resend the 1Password invite to your work email.
Jordan Park: DM'd the personal email. Thanks Luke.
IT Support: Jordan - quick checklist: 1) don't accept the personal Okta profile; 2) we can remove the personal email from your identity record; 3) for passkeys on Mac you should see the "Use passkey" option in Safari/Chrome when enrolling. Windows Hello prompt happens if the device fingerprint suggests Windows. Which browser are you using?
Jordan Park: Using Chrome 120.0 on macOS Sonoma 14.0. I only see "Security Key or Biometric" and it defaults to Windows Hello mention. Also I tried to add a YubiKey and it failed with "key not compatible".
Maria (IT): Two things: the duplicate Okta entry usually comes from GSuite aliases or a previous invite. Luke's removal should fix the invite routing. For the YubiKey error, check whether it's a U2F-only key vs FIDO2. YubiKeys older than certain firmware may need the "Use legacy U2F" toggle in Okta.
